summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate (May 2026) from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) focused on real-time perception and computer vision for robotics. Built YOLO-based obstacle and object detection, depth estimation, and camera+ToF sensor fusion deployed on embedded/Jetson platforms, plus ROS2-based robotic control and simulation pipelines (CARLA, MoveIt/RViz) for autonomous navigation. Proficient in Python/C++, Git, and Linux development workflows.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Built automated data pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~8,000 zero-annotation training frames.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7→10.9ms) for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
